connector.name: Secure Schema MCP
connector.registryDescription: Read-only MCP server for exposing database schema metadata without row data.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-secure-schema. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the siddharth-coder13 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: SQLAlchemy database URL used for schema inspection.

env.name: DATABASE_SCHEMA
env.description: Optional default schema or catalog namespace. In production it is locked and tool arguments cannot override it.

env.name: ALLOWED_TABLES
env.description: Optional comma-separated table/view allowlist. When set, only listed tables and views are visible.

env.name: SECURE_SCHEMA_ENV
env.description: Set to production to require ALLOWED_TABLES during startup.

env.name: FASTMCP_CHECK_FOR_UPDATES
env.description: Set to off to disable FastMCP startup update checks.

env.name: FASTMCP_SHOW_SERVER_BANNER
env.description: Set to false to suppress the FastMCP startup banner.
